title: Elastic component layout & cross-platform compatibility polish for Console pages
creator: Asha Menon
description: Goal: make dashboards, rollout pages, and cost views resilient across viewport sizes and browsers while preserving performance and a11y. Deliverables include a Figma prototype with tokenized spacing, a small interactive demo (HTML/CSS/vanilla JS) for chart/table fallback behavior, documented cross-browser bugs with reproduction steps, and an acceptance checklist for engineering handoff.
comments: 2026-02-13 - Asha: Kickoff review with PM and Eng. Agreed scope: charts (line/area), large tables with virtualization, modals and stacked dialogs, and the rollout timeline component.
2026-02-16 - Diego: Built HTML prototype showing elastic grid + column collapse rules. Noted Safari stacking context issue with sticky headers.
2026-02-18 - PM Nathan: Prioritize cost views first due to customer tickets around clipped charts in narrow panes.
2026-02-20 - Diego: Eng reported Firefox paint jitter when animating table row height. Decided to avoid layout-thrashing animations; use opacity/transform-only transitions for collapsed rows.
2026-02-22 - Design review: New token map for spacing and breakpoints accepted. Action: produce QA matrix and accessibility checklist.
2026-02-25 - Diego: Submitted initial PR to GH: github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/PRs/5681 for prototype styles and a11y tweaks. Linked below.
2026-02-25 - Asha: Usability quick test with 3 internal PMs. Notes captured in Drive doc. Minor wording changes requested for empty states in the rollout modal.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboards render without horizontal overflow on viewport widths 320px-2560px
Chart axes and tooltips remain readable and not clipped on Safari/Firefox/Chrome/Edge
Tables support column collapse and virtualization without layout jitter in Firefox and Safari
Modals (including stacked modals) maintain focus trapping, scroll locking, and proper z-index across target browsers
No regressions in keyboard navigation and screen-reader announcements for updated components
Prototype PR merged and documented handoff to ENG with CSS tokens and breakpoints
qa_checks: Manual cross-browser test matrix: Chrome (latest), Safari (macOS & iOS), Firefox (latest), Edge (latest)
Performance smoke: first meaningful paint for dashboard under 1s on staging with synthetic data
Accessibility checks: axe-core run and manual keyboard + NVDA/VoiceOver spot checks
Regression snapshots for charts and tables in Percy or equivalent visual diff tool
